text: You snatch the TELESCOPE from its TRIPOD. Who knows, it might be useful. But more importantly, it pushes the CRUXITE to the last card making it available for tinkering.
The PDA is predictably jettisoned into the yard, over the neighbor's fence.
alt: The telescope is captchalogued, ejecting the PDA.
command: John: Put cruxite on weird pattern on alchemiter.
